시편 73:1.content: A Psalm of Asaph. Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

시편 73:2.content: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

시편 73:3.content: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

시편 73:4.content: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

시편 73:5.content: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

시편 73:6.content: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.

시편 73:7.content: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

시편 73:8.content: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

시편 73:9.content: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

시편 73:10.content: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

시편 73:11.content: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

시편 73:12.content: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

시편 73:13.content: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

시편 73:14.content: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

시편 73:15.content: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

시편 73:16.content: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

시편 73:17.content: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.

시편 73:18.content: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

시편 73:19.content: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

시편 73:20.content: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

시편 73:21.content: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

시편 73:22.content: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

시편 73:23.content: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

시편 73:24.content: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

시편 73:25.content: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

시편 73:26.content: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

시편 73:27.content: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

시편 73:28.content: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord God, that I may declare all thy works.
